sso.title: App management
sso.description: Manage downstream apps connected to single sign-on (SSO), their callback URLs and visibility
sso.copyFailed: Copy failed, please select and copy manually
sso.resetConfirm: The current secret of "{{name}}" stops working immediately and the app must be updated. Continue?
sso.deleteConfirm: Delete app "{{name}}"? It will no longer be able to use single sign-on.

keys.title: Signing keys
keys.description: SSO tokens are signed with RS256; public keys are published to downstream apps through JWKS
keys.notice: After rotation the new key signs tokens immediately. The old key stays in JWKS for 7 days (already-issued tokens keep verifying) and is then removed automatically. The key is shared site-wide, so rotation affects every connected app.
keys.confirm: Rotate the signing key? The new key becomes the signing key immediately and the old key is removed after 7 days. Downstream apps pick up the new public key from JWKS; if any app hard-codes a public key, switch it to JWKS first.

form.nameTooLong: Name must be 50 characters or fewer
form.descTooLong: Description must be 200 characters or fewer
form.redirectHint: One per line. Must be a full https URL (http://localhost is allowed for local debugging)
form.redirectRequired: Enter at least one callback URL
form.redirectInvalid: Invalid callback URL: {{uri}} (must be a full https or localhost URL without a # fragment)
form.rolesHint: Leave empty to show the app to all signed-in users
form.logoUrlPlaceholder: Or enter a logo image URL
form.logoUploadHint: Square (1:1) works best; a transparent PNG or SVG looks cleanest.
form.homeUrlHint: Opened in a new tab when the card is clicked in the app center
form.urlInvalid: Enter a full URL starting with http(s)://
form.allowOrgReadHint: When on, the app can use client_credentials (scope org.read) to get a token and read this tenant's users and departments (/oauth/org/users, /oauth/org/depts). Turning it off invalidates issued tokens immediately.

secret.title: App secret
secret.onceHint: The Client Secret is shown only this once. You cannot view it again after closing, so copy and store it now. If lost, it can only be reset.

access.title: Integration info
access.hint: Use these endpoints in the downstream app with the OIDC / OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow

portal.title: App center

portal.emptyDesc: No apps have been made available to you yet. Please contact an administrator.
